q: How many shipments are currently marked as lost?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM shipments WHERE status = 'lost'

q: What is the total invoiced amount for express shipments?
gold: SELECT sum(i.amount_usd) FROM invoices i JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id WHERE s.service_level = 'express'

q: How many customers are in each tier?
gold: SELECT tier, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY tier

q: Which 5 customers have the highest total invoice amount? Return the customer name and total.
gold: SELECT c.name, sum(i.amount_usd) AS total FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON s.customer_id = c.id JOIN invoices i ON i.shipment_id = s.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

q: How many delivered shipments arrived after their promised date?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_at > promised_at

q: What is the invoice amount for shipment SHP-90003?
gold: SELECT amount_usd FROM invoices WHERE shipment_id = 'SHP-90003'

q: How many claims of each type are open?
gold: SELECT type, count(*) FROM claims WHERE status = 'open' GROUP BY type

q: What is the average shipment weight per service level, rounded to one decimal?
gold: SELECT service_level, round(avg(weight_kg), 1) FROM shipments GROUP BY service_level

q: How many invoices are overdue and what do they add up to?
gold: SELECT count(*), sum(amount_usd) FROM invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

q: List the ids of express shipments delivered 3 or more days late.
gold: SELECT id FROM shipments WHERE service_level = 'express' AND delivered_at - promised_at >= 3

q: Which destination city received the most shipments?
gold: SELECT destination FROM shipments GROUP BY destination ORDER BY count(*) DESC, destination LIMIT 1

q: How many shipments did Halden Robotics send?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM shipments s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE c.name = 'Halden Robotics'
